html:
Heat Stroke

hook: half hey to waves to circulate & progress to swing

by: Nicholas Rockstroh

formation: Becket ccw

Note next neighbors on right diagonal

A1 8
ladles chain
8
ladles start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends - and next neighbors take right hands ⁋
A2 0
form long waves - ladles face in, gentlespoons face out
8
balance & box circulate - ladles cross while gentlespoons loop right
8
partners swing
B1 8
gentlespoons chain
8
gentlespoons start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends - and neighbors take right hands
B2 0
form long waves - gentlespoons face in, ladles face out
8
balance & box circulate - gentlespoons cross while ladles loop right
8
partners swing

I just dug this up from The Caller's Box after forgetting for several years that it existed and decided it's probably worth calling. My original notes are as follows:

Also inspired by “Heat Wave” by Erik Hoffman. This one is a bit more complicated than “Heat Exhaustion” thanks to the mid-dance progression, but I like it better since it A: doesn’t start with a circle left 3/4x and B: has both a hey starting by the right shoulder and a hey starting by the left shoulder.
